learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: 70 products on /shop, four pages of 20 (Wix Stores, display only: $0.00, out of stock). NY-only brand (Veterans Holdings, OCM-PROC-24-000069, Gloversville).
notes: Wix renders the /shop gallery server-side 20 at a time and honours ?page=N; page 5 is empty, where the reader stops. Each page is about 1.2 MB, and Wix answered 429 to back-to-back fetches on 2026-10-05 after a burst of exploration; a check a few minutes later went through. store-products-sitemap.xml lists the same 70 products if the gallery ever changes.

Names are '<SIZE> | <FORMAT> | <STRAIN>' in capitals: '1G | 510 CARTRIDGE | MIMOSA', '1G | AIO | RUNTZ', '1G | LIVE RESIN STONE | GG4', '1G | LIVE RESIN BADDER | GMO', '2G | DAB DART | SOUR TANGIE', '1G | N’FUSED PRE-ROLL | GOLDEN TICKET'. The size segment is the size; there are no packs.

The Stone is the brand's rechargeable resin all-in-one (nav: 'Resin All-In-One'; /knowthestone), so Live/Cured Resin Stone is an all-in-one with line Live Resin or Cured Resin. 510 Cartridge and AIO are the distillate line and carry no line.

Concentrates keep the texture in the line ('Live Resin Badder', 'Live Resin Sugar', 'Cured Sugar', 'Crumble', 'Honeycomb'): GG4, BBS and The Eclipse come as both badder and sugar, which would otherwise be one entry. The Dab Dart is a 2g concentrate applicator ('Our 2g Dab Dart makes dabbing or refilling effortless'). N'Fused pre-rolls are infused with bubble hash and distillate.
The 12oz Honey Spritzers say 'THC: 10 mg per serving' but not how many servings a can holds, and no NY store sells them at 2+ stores, so they are skipped rather than given a dose.
title_case leaves three-letter capitalised words as they are ('ICE Cream Cake', 'KEY Lime PIE', 'THE Eclipse'), which keeps GG4, BBS, GMO and MAC right.

skip.why: 12oz spritzer: 10mg per serving, servings per can not stated

title.match: ^(?P<size>\d*\.?\d+\s*G)\s*\|\s*(?P<line>LIVE RESIN BADDER|CURED RESIN BADDER|LIVE RESIN SUGAR|CURED SUGAR|CRUMBLE|HONEYCOMB)\s*\|\s*(?P<strain>.+?)\s*$
